I haven't saved the Thornbury draft yet. It's waiting for approval because the $2,101 per-seat rate is a finance figure. Finance figures can only go to Anselm Grieve (CFO), June Osei-Lark (deal desk) and the account owner. Anyone else needs Anselm's or June's approval. Hollis Mbeki is the Central team lead, so he isn't on that list, and you owning the account doesn't change that.

- **Approval:** I sent June a direct message asking for approval and logged the request as pending. Nothing will be saved before she or Anselm says yes.
- **Your reply:** I answered you in the thread with the draft text. Once it's approved, it'll be saved to your drafts as: To Hollis Mbeki (hmbeki@pemberline.com), subject "Thornbury 2027 rate", a short note giving Thornbury Cloth Co.'s proposed 2027 rate of $2,101 a seat from your call yesterday. You can still change the wording before then.
